test_title: PYST 134: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 27 Jan,, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the word segment that substitutes (replaces) the bracketed word segment correctly and completes the sentence meaningfully.**

Wear rubber gloves while chopping chillies (as it could irritate the skin).

options.text: as these could irritate the skin
as they can irritate the skin
as it would irritate the skin
as these would irritate the skin

solution:
The correct answer is: **as they can irritate the skin**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The original sentence talks about wearing rubber gloves while chopping chillies because it could irritate the skin.
 
• The correct replacement for '**it could irritate the skin**' is '**they can irritate the skin**.'
 
• '**They**' refers to the chillies being chopped, which is the subject of the sentence.
 
• Using '**can**' implies a certainty.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.
